name: Waniwani
description: Manage your AI distribution agents, monitor how ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini present your product, and drill into session analytics for the AI presence you run on Waniwani.ai.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Waniwani to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Waniwani to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.waniwani.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Waniwani MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Waniwani provides these MCP tools: execute, search, set_active_org, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Waniwani?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Waniwani in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Waniwani requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Waniwani is developed by Waniwani. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
